endings.emptyHint: Add at least one ending entry — leave at 0 to skip this bullet entirely.
endings.videoRangeHint: Each video covers a contiguous slice of endings. Default split is balanced; adjust per row to override.
endings.multiVideoOutputNote: Each video's description renders that video's ending slice. Generate from the editor as usual — switch which video the Output previews using the selector below.
endings.videoIndexHint: Output preview, title, and tags update to reflect the selected video's ending slice. Copy each one separately to publish per-video.

warnings.singleEmpty: Fill at least the number or the name — empty entries are dropped from the description.
warnings.timelineShort: Timeline needs {{needed}} ending markers; only {{found}} found. Add the missing rows before copying.
warnings.rangeInvalid: Video {{video}}: range {{from}}–{{to}} is invalid (out of bounds or reversed).
warnings.rangeGap: Endings {{at}}+ are not covered by any video — extend a range or add a video.
warnings.rangeOverlap: Multiple videos cover ending {{at}} — adjust ranges to avoid overlap.
warnings.rangeShort: Last covered ending is {{at}} but there are {{total}} endings — final video range is too short.

runtime.title: Something went wrong

settings.title: Settings
settings.showGameCopyright: Append © game studio credit (right after store links)
settings.showGameCopyrightHint: Adds a “© [publisher]. All rights reserved.” line crediting the game's developer or publisher right under the store links. Use this when the dev/publisher contractually requires attribution in the description. Reads the studio name from the “Studio / Publisher” field in Game Info — leaves the line out if that field is empty.
settings.showUsagePolicy: Append usage policy block to description
settings.showSponsorCredit: Show sponsor credit line in description (thanks for the key)
settings.showThirdPartyAds: Show third-party advertising block in description
settings.thirdPartyAdsHint: Set ad copy in your channel profile (Profiles → Edit).
settings.splitContactEmailHint: Adds Advertising and Game keys & playtest email fields, shown as a grouped block in the description.
settings.showTranslationQualityHint: Adds an AI-translation disclaimer to descriptions generated in languages other than English and Vietnamese.
settings.showPinnedCommentTemplate: Generate a pinned-comment template alongside output
settings.pinnedCommentIncludeAskNextGame: Include "what game should I play next?" prompt
settings.pinnedCommentIncludeGenrePlaylist: Include genre-playlist suggestion in pinned comment
settings.genrePlaylistsHelp: Configure a YouTube playlist URL per genre. The pinned-comment template will auto-suggest the matching playlist when the video's primary genre is selected.
settings.genrePlaylistsEmptyHint: Leave empty to skip a genre.
settings.logRetentionHint: Logs older than this are deleted at app start. Range: 1–90 days.
settings.strictModeHint: Block Generate, Copy and Export while any field has an error. Soft warnings still let you through.

backup.intro: One file with everything you've saved — profiles, presets, templates, history, settings and the current draft. Use Back up and Restore at the top of this page, or drop a backup file below.
backup.exportHint: Choose what to include. Settings never carry your legal consent or which panels are open.
backup.dropHint: Drop a backup file here to restore it
backup.legacyFound: Found data saved by an older version of YTDescGen. Review it to restore anything that's missing.

auto.title: Automatic backups
auto.hint: The desktop app keeps the last 10 backups in its own folder, saved after your library changes.

restore.title: Restore data
restore.metaUnknown: made by an older version of YTDescGen
restore.mergeHint: Adds what's new and keeps everything you already have.
restore.replaceHint: Makes each chosen section match the file — items that aren't in it are removed.
restore.conflicts: Items in both places that differ
restore.newerHint: An item is updated only if the file's copy was changed more recently.
restore.bothHint: The file's copy is added next to yours, with a number after its name.
restore.settingsNote: Different from yours. Your legal consent and open panels stay as they are.
restore.draftNote: Replaces what's in the editor now.
restore.empty: There's nothing in this file to restore.
restore.replaceRemoves: Replace will remove {{n}} item(s) that aren't in the file. You can undo it right after.
restore.nothing: Nothing to restore — everything in this file is already here.

errors.newer: This file was made by a newer version of YTDescGen. Update the app to open it.
